triage.kind_span: The Gabelli Equity Trust Inc. (the “Fund”, “we”, “us” or “our”) is issuing subscription rights (the “Rights”) to our common stockholders (the “Common Shareholders”) to purchase additional shares of common stock

subject_names.span: The Gabelli Equity Trust Inc. (the “Fund”, “we”, “us” or “our”) is issuing subscription rights (the “Rights”) to our common stockholders

subject_tickers.span: The Common Shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) under the symbol “GAB.”

security_class.span: One transferable subscription right (a “Right”) will be issued for each share of common stock of the Fund

rights_per_share.span: One Right will be issued in respect of each Common Share of the Fund outstanding as of the close of business on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: Ten Rights will be required to purchase one Common Share.

price_reference.span: Ten Rights may be exercised at a price of $5.50 per Common Share (the “Subscription Price”).

record_date.span: Rights will be issued to holders of record of the Fund’s Common Shares as of the close of business on June 2, 2021 (the “Record Date”).

expiration_date.span: The Rights may be exercised at any time after issuance and prior to expiration of the Rights (the “Subscription Period”), which will be 5:00 PM Eastern Time on July 14, 2021 (the “Expiration Date”), unless otherwise extended.

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE under the symbol “GAB RT”.

over_subscription.span: An over-subscription privilege will be offered, subject to the right of the Board of Directors of the Fund (the “Board”) to eliminate the over-subscription privilege.

max_new_shares.span: 26,266,993 Common Shares of the Fund will be issued if all Rights are exercised.

notes: 424B2 prospectus supplement (dated June 2, 2021) for a transferable rights offering by The Gabelli Equity Trust Inc. (NYSE: GAB; rights to trade as 'GAB RT'). Subscription price is a fixed $5.50 per Common Share, so price_reference = fixed and price_pct / price_floor_pct_nav are null. For context the cover states NAV $6.87 and last sale $7.54 on May 28, 2021 (last trading date before ex-Rights). One Right per Common Share (rounded up to a number divisible by ten), ten Rights per new share; 262,669,923 Rights for 26,266,993 shares; Common Shares outstanding 262,669,923 as of May 28, 2021. Over-subscription privilege limited to Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise, allocated pro rata, and the Board may eliminate it up to the fifth day after expiration; if NAV exceeds the subscription price, over-subscription shares will not take the ratio beyond one new share per three Rights. The Fund will not sell shares not subscribed for, so max_new_shares is the 26,266,993 primary amount. Subscription period June 2, 2021 to 5:00 PM ET July 14, 2021, unless extended; last rights trading day July 13, 2021; issuance July 21, 2021. New shares do not receive the June 23, 2021 quarterly distribution. Offering made without stockholder approval under the SEC staff interpretation of the 1940 Act. The excerpt also carries the start of the base prospectus dated December 23, 2020, cut inside its 'Market Discount Risk' section.
